# Repository instructions


## Development workflows

- For agent scaffolding, prompt iteration, architecture, and local test guidance, follow the [team guide](../docs/team-guide.md) and [local testing guide](../docs/local-testing.md). Prompt changes should be evaluated with `AGENT_RUNTIME=copilot npm run eval` before `npm run build`.
- `docs/CATALOG.md` is generated by `npm run build`; do not edit it by hand.
- Marketplace bundles are packaged with `npm run package` and published from version tags. Follow the [distribution guide](../docs/distribution.md) for release and installation steps. Published modernization plugins require a configured platform checkout through `L2_PLATFORM_ROOT`; installation does not download the runtime.
